name: Image Room Banana Club
original_name: イメージルーム バナナ倶楽部
source:
Protagonist wanders the Christmas night town without money and in desperation till a flier of Banana Club flies in his face. He reaches the written address and decides to play by the rules of the club.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-december-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
圣诞夜，身无分文又陷入绝望的主角在街头游荡，直到一张“香蕉俱乐部”的传单飞到他脸上。他来到传单所写的地址，决定按照俱乐部的规矩参与游戏。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-december-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]]
